subject: Goalcraft & Scenario Sprint: annual planning orientation
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@prospectco.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Goalcraft & Scenario Sprint: annual planning orientation

Team —

Kicking off a focused sprint this week to align executive goals, scenario targets, and the QBR-ready timeline. High level ask: get us to a one-page Go/Stretch target slate + scenario inputs by the end of next week (Mar 7).

Attachments: Annual_Planning_Playbook_v0.1.pdf; QBR_timeline_2027.xlsx; scenario_template_v2.csv
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bGoalcraftSprint
JIRA ticket: PLNG-4212

Key objectives for the sprint:
- Produce a compact target slate (Go / Stretch / Contingency) per org.
- Define 3 credible scenarios (Base, Downside 1, Upside 1) with explicit assumptions.
- Lock procurement/commit windows and resource asks for Q2 execution.

Immediate asks:
1) Everyone: drop org-level Go/Stretch back-of-envelope numbers in the scenario_template_v2.csv by EOD Wed (Mar 3).
2) Marissa: please highlight capacity/resource pinch points and where we might need hiring or contractors.
3) Laura: confirm procurement lead times for key vendor spend and any contract renewal windows that affect Q2.
4) Vivek: I'll need a 15-min sync to validate executive-level triggers Friday morning.

I'll host a 45-min orientation at 10:30am PT tomorrow to walk through the playbook and timeline. Invite attached.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Annual_Planning_Playbook_v0.1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: QBR_timeline_2027.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: scenario_template_v2.csv (csv)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Goalcraft & Scenario Sprint: annual planning orientation

Ben — thanks for owning this. Quick notes from my side:

- Appreciate the tight timeline; let's keep the first pass lightweight. The one-page slate should focus on net new ARR, gross churn, and product velocity assumptions (new features/week).
- For scenario assumptions, call out hardware/capacity risk explicitly (we're seeing variable capacity pricing into Q3).
- On the exec sync Friday: 9:00am PT works better for me. If that conflicts we'll find a short slot.

I'll add a small appendix with the executive trigger ladder (when we hit X ARR or Y spend we flip to contingency plans).

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 11:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Goalcraft & Scenario Sprint: annual planning orientation

Thanks Ben — I like the structure. A couple of clarifying asks from GTM/resource planning: 

- Scenario template: can we add a column for "Capacity cost delta" and "Expected infra spend per ARR"? That will help quantify hardware-driven downside.
- Hiring/contractors: I'll push a 'triage' tier field so we can label positions as Critical / Nice-to-have / Deferred. I'll drop a first-pass list in the drive by Wed EOD.
- Dependencies: tagging needed for product deliverables (we'll need product feature readiness dates to align ramp). Can Stephanie own a consolidated dependency list?

Action items I'm taking:
1) Populate scenario_template_v2.csv with org-level numbers (base + stretch) by Mar 3 EOD.
2) Upload a 6wk resource ramp plan and contractor cost estimate (in the drive).

Hi Ben / Laura —

Thanks for including me. From the ProspectCo side, procurement windows are:
- Major contracts (>$250k): 6–8 weeks lead time for RFP + legal redline cycle.
- Smaller integrations: 2–3 weeks if we can use our standard SOW.

We can align to your QBR timeline but will need the initial SOW draft by Mar 9 to make the Mar 31 target. Happy to jump on the orientation tomorrow to clarify.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
CFO, ProspectCo

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 14:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Goalcraft & Scenario Sprint: annual planning orientation

Ben — quick procurement notes: 

- Vendor renewals: we have three contracts (monitoring, hosting, and observability tooling) that have mid-April renewal windows. If we plan to re-bid, we need scope locked by Mar 15.
- Capex vs Opex: for hardware commitments >$300k we need finance approval and a 4-week procurement lead time (due diligence and PO cycle).
- I'll upload a vendor timing matrix to the Drive; see the file prospect_vendor_timing.csv.

I'll coordinate with Elena (cc'ed earlier) on any external timelines. Stephanie — please add the vendor matrix to the shared playbook.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick replies — good alignment so far. Quick recap of owners and next steps (actionable):

- Ben: run orientation (10:30am PT tomorrow) + capture exec triggers doc (Vivek to review) — owner: Ben — due: Mar 1 EOD.
- Marissa: populate scenario_template_v2.csv with Go/Stretch numbers and resource ramp — owner: Marissa — due: Mar 3 EOD.
- Stephanie: consolidate dependency list and add vendor matrix to the Drive — owner: Stephanie — due: Mar 4 EOD.
- Laura: upload vendor timing matrix and confirm capex windows — owner: Laura — due: Mar 3 EOD.
- External (Elena): ProspectCo procurement windows acknowledged; will share SOW template if needed — target for SOW draft: Mar 9.

I'll update JIRA PLNG-4212 with the above owners and due dates after the orientation. If anyone needs to reshuffle, flag immediately.

Thanks all — looking forward to a tight but lightweight sprint.

Ben
